description: The donut chart, titled “Stimuli Type,” visually represents the proportional distribution of different types of stimuli used in the context of generative AI’s application in journalism, as referenced in the paper “Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism.” The chart is divided into nine distinct segments, each labeled with a stimulus category and its corresponding percentage. The largest segment, colored dark red, represents “Press Release” at 21.9%. Following this, “External News Article” (13.1%, dark green), “Interview” (10.2%, dark blue), and two equal-sized segments—“Organizational Report” and “Event Posting” (both 8.8%, shades of purple)—are shown. Smaller segments include “Organizational Website” (6.6%, light blue), “Social Media Post” (1.5%, light green), and “Intra-agency news article” (0.7%, yellow-orange). A grayed-out segment appears on the top right but lacks a label or percentage, suggesting it may be an unclassified or placeholder category. Percentages are displayed next to each labeled slice, and the segments are arranged in descending order clockwise from the top-right, with no exploded or emphasized slices. The central white space contains the title “Stimuli Type” in bold black text.
